title: Invoice intake — hybrid portal + email fallback guidance for PO-split cases
text:
Invoice intake — hybrid portal + email fallback guidance for PO-split cases

messages_1_body:
Hi Diego,

We’re getting Orchid Systems set up as a supplier and have a couple quick questions about Redwood’s invoice intake. Our AP team usually sends invoices by email, but if there’s a portal that’s preferred we can start there.

Specifically:
- We will be billing against a single PO that will be fulfilled in 3 shipments over the next 6 weeks. Can we submit multiple invoices against the same PO? If so, what fields do you need to tie them back (PO number, shipment reference, line-item IDs)?
- If we use email as a fallback, is there a required subject token or header format so ingestion is automatic?
- Any sample invoice PDF (field names and placement) you prefer? I attached a draft (orchid_invoice_sample.pdf).

Also, can you confirm the expected acknowledgement SLA so we know when to expect confirmation?

Thanks,
Sophie Tran
Finance Lead, Orchid Systems
sophie.tran@orchidsys.com
(415) 555-0192

messages_2_body:
Hi Sophie — thanks for the details and the sample.

Short answers up front:
- Portal preferred for new vendors (single source of truth + better ACK visibility). Email is supported as a fallback but requires a defined subject token so our ingestion pipeline can route and automatically ACK.
- You may submit multiple invoices against one PO. Required keys we use: PO Number (exact alphanumeric match), Invoice Date, Invoice Number, line-item quantity and unit price. If you have shipment references (ASN/Shipment ID) include them in the invoice line description so we can match receipts.

Guidance and next steps:
1) Please complete the vendor onboarding form I’ve attached (orchid_onboarding_form.xlsx). We’ll provision a vendor ID once that’s returned and validated.
2) Portal: once vendor ID is active you can upload invoices directly (recommended). Portal ACKs are recorded in the Console and we aim to show successful ingest within 24 hours.
3) Email fallback: use subject token AP-ORCHID-<vendor_id>. Until vendor_id is provisioned, prefix emails with AP-ORCHID-PENDING and include the onboarding form to avoid manual delays. Example subject: "AP-ORCHID-PENDING | PO 4532-77 | INV 2028-1001". Attach PDFs or structured XML if available.
4) Template: we prefer a compact, machine-readable table on the first page with columns: PO, Invoice#, Invoice Date, Line#, Description, Qty, Unit Price, Tax, Total. If you can embed the PO number in the invoice filename that helps as well (e.g., 4532-77_INV2028-1001.pdf).

I’ve cc’d Monica (AP mapping) to confirm required metadata fields and Marissa (vendor ops) for provisioning cadence.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: orchid_onboarding_form.xlsx (vendor setup form, required fields: legal name, remit address, W-9/TIN, bank remittance, contact + AP email)

messages_4_body:
Hi Sophie — Monica from AP here.

A few specifics to help your team format invoices for smooth ingest:
- Please include Tax ID on the first page footer if possible. If not, include it in the onboarding form; we will manually add the TIN to the vendor record but that may delay automated tax reporting.
- QR codes: we currently do not parse QR payloads into our ingestion flow. Please keep human-readable PO and invoice fields in the PDF/text layer.
- Required fields for automated routing: PO number, Invoice#, Invoice Date, Supplier Name (exact legal name), Total Amount, and remittance bank details (if you expect ACH/POP). Line-level SKU/description helps match receipts but not strictly required for routing.
- Subject line template (email fallback): "AP-ORCHID-<vendor_id> | PO <PO#> | INV <Invoice#>". If vendor_id is PENDING, use AP-ORCHID-PENDING as Diego suggested.

Provisioning timeline: once we receive the completed onboarding form and W-9, vendor ID is typically created within 1–2 business days. We will email you the vendor_id and the final subject token to use for future emails.

If you want, Marissa can provision temporary portal access for file uploads while vendor_id is being set up — Marissa, pls confirm if you can do a temporary account.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Accounts Payable, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
